gazetteer_names_needed.name: Danube Delta
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: delta of the Danube (Romania/Ukraine, Tulcea and Odesa oblast); seat of the Danubian Sich 1775-1828 (successor land)

gaps.what: No boundary or area for the Free Lands; all Cliopatria outlines 1662-1772 are ok with extent unverified; extent under Ottoman suzerainty 1711-1734 and the 1654 Pereyaslav split of Hetmanate and Zaporizhzhia not drawn
Russo-Polish War 1654-1667, Great Northern War, Eternal Peace 1686, Treaty of Belgrade 1739 and Russo-Turkish War 1768-1774 pages not opened; only 1709, 1711 and 1775 are war entries beyond Andrusovo
Keyframe 1552-1661 is a soft 100 km core round Zaporizhzhia at confidence 2; the Commonwealth's 1583-1657 claim over the same land is not reconciled
No area, boundary, regiment founding years, Belgorod/Izium line dates; keyframe 1650-1669 is the 1670 outline carried back at confidence 1; the 1752 outline change is unexplained

problems: sloboda-ukraine and ukraine share Wikidata Q598570 in Cliopatria; they are different states (Cossack frontier region under the tsar vs the 1992 republic). Kept as separate dossiers, id kept as Cliopatria gives it; the shared id is a Cliopatria data fault.

Vassalage from the Zaporozhian side has no event type: the Sich page infobox gives de jure vassal of Poland-Lithuania 1583-1654, Muscovy 1654-1709, Ottoman Empire 1711-1734, Russian Empire 1734-1775, and the 1667 Andrusovo condominium of Russia and Poland-Lithuania. The polish-lithuanian-commonwealth, tsardom-of-russia, ottoman-empire and russian-empire dossiers should carry vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart zaporozhian-cossacks.

ottoman-empire dossier: 1677 loss of right-bank Ukraine to zaporozhian-cossacks (confidence 1) is not matched by the Zaporozhian shape (two cells added in 1677); its 1739 cession of the Zaporozhye region to Russia is not in the pages opened here.

zaporozhian-cossacks start moved from Cliopatria's 1662 to 1552 (Sich page infobox c. 1552) with a new soft core keyframe 1552-1661; the end moved 1774 to 1775 (1772 shape adjust, years only). Drop the 1552 keyframe if the renderer must not draw a Cossack core inside the Commonwealth.

sloboda-ukraine written as type colony, family russia, start 1650, end 1765 (1763 shape adjust, years only; Cliopatria runs 1670-1768). Cliopatria's Tsardom of Russia shape has no cell in common with it.

Page budget: zaporozhian-cossacks used 5 content pages (budget 5) plus one disambiguation page (Nova Serbia) and one failed URL as extra fetches; sloboda-ukraine used 2 pages, the second (Sloboda Cossacks) repeated the first.
Capital coordinates of the Sich sites are approximate positions, not from the pages; the years are the Sich page's table.
